Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Ahmad Hussain DBA Guardian Testing to host a Covid Testing Site for Rapid and
  PCR Results Event at 101 W. Manchester Blvd., Inglewood Public Library, from April

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Lee Hanzy DBA Menage Entertainment to host a Vibz Vendor Event at 313 N. La

  No.00341052)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #3:  Daniel Kash DBA LAX AMMO Sale, to host an LAX AMMO Parking Lot Sales Event

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #4:  Joinel Dixon DBA Dixon Family Walk, to host a GL Dixon 5K Walk Event at 3400 W.

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #5:  Elje Kibbler - Vermaas DBA Yola/LA Philharmonic to host a Celebrate Inglewood –

  p.m. (Activity No. 00340965)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #7:  Faron Smith Jr. DBA True Belizean to host a Belize Fest Event on Nutwood St.,

  p.m. (Activity No. 00341188)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
